args.title: Triage issue 4406
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

In src/ingest/parser.ts, parseStatement splits the input by '\n' and pops lines if the last line is empty. When a file ends with an empty line (e.g. trailing newline), lines array gets an extra empty string at the end which lines.pop() removes. However, if a file ends with multiple consecutive empty lines (or if text.split('\n') produces multiple empty strings at the end due to trailing newlines/carriage returns), lines.pop() only removes the single last element. This leaves a trailing empty string in lines, which is then processed as a row, resulting in fields = [""] and triggering a 'Malformed row' error (errors.rowShape) on the row just past the last transaction.
